title: An Ext square from the endpoints of a derived mate
statement: For abelian categories C,D with their supplied derived categories and Ext smallness, an exact additive restriction functor H:D -> C, functors F and G from B to their derived categories, and a family of natural comparisons tau_i:F -> G followed by D(H), suppose a unique normalized i satisfies the supported-source equation and every normalized i satisfies the shifted-target equation. Supply an arrow beta and Ext classes r and a with their respective realized source/target equations. Then mk0(eta) composed with H(a) equals r composed with mk0(theta). All four endpoint and realization hypotheses remain independent.

source.place: paragraph (1), finite cyclic reduction followed by finite coefficient extension

proof.text: Eliminate the source existence proposition, apply the independent target proposition to the same normalized comparison, then use naturality at beta. Cancel the supported-source isomorphism and apply Ext.homEquiv together with the exact-functor single and shift formulas.

proof_origin.place: paragraph (1), finite cyclic reduction followed by finite coefficient extension
proof_origin.note: Separate the supported-constant and positive-root endpoint calculations from naturality of an arbitrary diagonal arrow.

theorem finiteCoefficient_extSquare_of_endpoints
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] [HasDerivedCategory C] [HasExt C]
    {D : Type u'} [Category.{v'} D] [Abelian D] [HasDerivedCategory D] [HasExt D]
    (H : D ⥤ C) [H.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits H] [PreservesFiniteColimits H]
    {B : Type*} [Category B]
    (F : B ⥤ DerivedCategory C) (G : B ⥤ DerivedCategory D)
    {I : Type*} (τ : I → (F ⟶ G ⋙ H.mapDerivedCategory)) (P : I → Prop)
    {S T : B} {X Y : C} {X' Y' : D}
    (sR : F.obj S ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj X)
    (sA : G.obj S ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor D 0).obj X')
    (tR : F.obj T ⟶ ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj Y)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
    (tA : G.obj T ⟶ ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor D 0).obj Y')⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
    (β : S ⟶ T) (r : Ext X Y 2) (a : Ext X' Y' 2)
    (η : X ⟶ H.obj X') (θ : Y ⟶ H.obj Y')
    (hs : ∃! i : I, P i ∧ (τ i).app S ≫ H.mapDerivedCategory.map sA.hom ≫
        (H.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).hom.app X' =
      sR.hom ≫ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).map η)
    (ht : ∀ i : I, P i → (τ i).app T ≫ H.mapDerivedCategory.map tA ≫
        (H.mapDerivedCategory.commShiftIso (2 : ℤ)).hom.app _ ≫
        ((H.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).hom.app Y')⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧' =
      tR ≫ ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).map θ)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧')
    (hr : sR.hom ≫ r.hom = F.map β ≫ tR)
    (ha : sA.hom ≫ a.hom = G.map β ≫ tA) :
    (Ext.mk₀ η).comp (a.mapExactFunctor H) (zero_add 2) =
      r.comp (Ext.mk₀ θ) (add_zero 2)
